title: 営業外
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: professionally confident WORKING Minto, black long hair/green eyes, devil horns and black/NEON GREEN costume, teasingly winks and says 「好きになっちゃうよ♡」 Hajime smiles. RIGHT ②: AFTER WORK same woman in BEIGE CARDIGAN/white blouse/DARK LONG SKIRT, NO horns, SAME black long hair and green eyes. Hajime sincerely tells her 「俺は、好きです。」 Her brain humorously freezes: she is blushing enormously with wide eyes, tiny pink cartoon computer error rectangles orbit her head, one big readable caption 「応答なし」. Not a medical emergency, not a robot body; simple romantic overload visual.
